text: **A check joins the schema property set to `data-model.md`'s table rows per entity and REFUSES IN BOTH DIRECTIONS**: a property with no row (a field shipped with no contract), and a row with no property (a contract describing something nobody implemented). Both, because they fail differently and the second is the more dangerous half -- it is what made `issue.body` look specified while it was homeless. **It is a SIBLING of `drift_check.sh`, never an arm of it**: that check compares generated faces to the Rust types, this compares a prose document to a schema, and folding them puts two questions behind one exit code.
